page.overview:
Who is Corrin VI?

Emperor Corrin VI was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 1897–1908 AG and 1935 AG) during the Era of the Princes, succeeding his father Corrin V as ruler of the Corrino Imperium.

Corrin VI was deposed in 1908 and his father was restored to the throne. Corrin VI was himself restored to the throne in 1935, succeeding Sidir VI, but was deposed again in the same year, again in favor of his father.
